dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical and continuous 2D narrowing from the mid-section toward the visible posterior extremity.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey median pixel intensity; transitional between juvenile slate and mature white phases.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Diffuse, low-frequency patches of darker pixels visible on the posterior third of the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradients with no sharp edges between varying levels of grey pigmentation.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A thin, light-colored linear feature extending diagonally from the mid-right margin toward the central axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single prominent diagonal linear scar on the mid-posterior dorsal plane.
other_distinctive_markers: The blowhole is visible as a high-contrast dark aperture on the anterior dorsal surface.
